reason: I already pay about 20 a month for Claude with a project per client, and that does the same job. Coast doesn't publish and doesn't do approvals, so it would be one more subscription on top of my scheduler.
objection: With 8 to 20 clients I'd need Pro at 49, which is more than double what I pay now, for something my current setup already does. The calendar is just another place to copy text out of.
would_change_my_mind: Client approvals that work over WhatsApp or email screenshots, or publishing straight to my scheduler, so it replaces a tool I pay for instead of adding one.
